decision.recommended_order: Run the real q32 configuration/pattern miter before using integrated selected-slice DC as evidence; standalone leaf DC may run in parallel, but neither creates a speed claim.
decision.reason: Both M408 seals verify; an independent all-record arithmetic/identity audit reproduces every one of the 442368 physical records; an exact-SHA Synopsys VCS rebuild and full rerun reproduces 772569 ordered contributions with zero mismatch/assertion failure; and a second VCS-bound procedural probe proves all 330201 wide low/high pairs complete in order. No P0/P1 remains in this static-codec milestone.

paper_identity_reproduced.catalog_population: M73 disjoint DSEC train-only S32 over 18 sequences

provenance_checks.explanation: M40 is the frozen runtime context inherited through M401. The M408 static codec stimulus itself is generated from the checkpoint-bound M41 weights and M73/M338 train-only q32 center catalog; it does not replay M40 runtime rows.

independent_all_record_audit.metric_namespace: 42467328 are source lanes. 74166624 are contribution lanes after wide blocks are decomposed into separate low and signed-high contributions; they are not independent source lanes.

coverage_interpretation.explanation: The main TB calls $finish after the final wide-high contribution drains. VCS reports the terminal two-cycle SVA cover one match short, while the independent same-edge procedural probe observes the final pair and ends with pending=0. Functional metadata/data/counter ledgers cover both contributions of every wide block, so this is terminal cover accounting, not a dropped contribution.
coverage_interpretation.full_population_policy: M408 intentionally drives contribution_ready=1 and injects no attacks.
coverage_interpretation.separate_directed_evidence: Exact-SHA M405R3 elastic directed VCS covers 147 output stalls and 4 protocol attacks with 0 atomic leak; the integration test covers 2 global-fault attacks and sticky global quiescence.

reviewer_execution_note.initial_attempt: The first independent wrapper stopped before compile because the reviewer confused the first entry in RUN_MANIFEST.sha256 with the SHA of that manifest file.
reviewer_execution_note.impact: None: no RTL or simulation executed in that attempt. The failed preflight directory is preserved, the expected digest was corrected, and both exact-SHA full recompilation/simulation and the second terminal-pair VCS run then passed.

findings.title: Terminal SVA wide-pair cover is one short
findings.detail: cp_wide_pair reports 330200 although there are 330201 wide blocks. The last stimulus block is wide; an independently bound procedural VCS probe counts low/high/pairs=330201/330201/330201, pending=0, order errors=0. Treat the SVA count as a finish-edge coverage artifact, not as the functional population ledger.

findings.title: Full-population replay has no backpressure or fault injection
findings.detail: M408 holds contribution_ready high and therefore covers neither cp_output_stall nor cp_fault. This is acceptable for the all-record arithmetic gate because M405R3 separately covers 147 stalls, 4 adapter attacks, 2 shell attacks and zero atomic leak, but population-plus-stall interaction is not claimed.

findings.title: M40 runtime identity is inherited, not exercised by the static codec
findings.detail: The identity chain to H67 ep35/no_running/M40 S10 and the M73 train-only q32 catalog is valid. However, this stimulus enumerates catalog-center PWP blocks from M41 weights; it does not consume M40 runtime rows. Runtime matcher occurrence/order must be proved by the next real q32 configuration/pattern miter.

findings.title: Static adapter VCS is not selected-slice or M384 lifecycle integration
findings.detail: M408 instantiates the elastic PWP issue adapter only. It does not exercise the q32 serial matcher, real configuration acceptance, M384 dual replay, or M384 phase_done-to-release obligation.

findings.title: No performance or physical claim transfers
findings.detail: This milestone admits exact static codec RTL behavior only. It creates no new speedup and does not admit RTL-realtrace cycles, system speedup, DC/Formality/PT, physical SRAM, SAIF/PTPX energy, paper PPA or a DATE headline.
